column2: When this codebase builds an HNSW graph, what is the default maximum number of connections per node? Give the constant name, its value, and the file that defines it.
What exact formula does the default BM25 scoring implementation use to compute IDF from docFreq and docCount? Write the expression.
What is the maximum length, in bytes, of a single indexed term, and how is that limit derived? Give the numeric value and the two constants involved.
What is the default RAM buffer size (in MB) that the index writer uses before flushing, and which constant holds it?
When you open a filesystem directory without naming a concrete implementation, what decides which implementation you actually get, and what are the two possible outcomes?
What is the default limit on the number of clauses a boolean query may contain, and in which class is that limit actually defined?
In the default merge policy, what percentage of deleted documents is tolerated in the index before merges are triggered to reclaim them, and what is the field called?
What is the minimum Java language version this project requires to build, and which file declares it?
